method: For each pair of consecutive ayahs, the gap from the previous ayah's voiced end to the next ayah's voiced start, and the VOICED time inside it: 40 ms frames (20 ms hop) louder than the surah's speech level - 30 dB whose normalised autocorrelation peak at 70-400 Hz is >= 0.6, after 250 ms margins at both ends. Breathing and room noise are unvoiced; recitation is voiced. With --controls, also the same measure for synthetic gaps spanning one whole ayah (previous-but- one ayah's end to the next ayah's start): negative controls, which must always show recitation.
